newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans close higher on Refco Inc buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans close higher on Refco Inc buying.

text.p: Buying by Refco Inc in March soybean futures and March soybean calls boosted CBOT soybean futures to a higher close, capping an abbreviated session, traders said.
"Refco bought the options and futures and that started the rally," said Vic Lespinasse of Dean Witter.
The key firm bought 800 March out-of-the-money $7.25 calls at 7-1/4 to nine cents and bought 3.5 million bushels of March futures, the traders said.
Cargill Investor Services and Prudential Securities each bought two million bushels of March futures, traders said.
Traders said the buying probably was short covering.
"It probably was short covering before the holiday. There was no news and South American weather is still very good," Lespinasse said.
Soybean futures volume was estimated at 25,000 contracts, below the 30,173 traded Monday, according to the CBOT.

In soybean options, in addition to call buying by Refco, Smith Barney sold 100 March $7.75 calls at two cents. Soybean options volume was tabbed at 7,000 contracts, above Monday's 3,178. Soybeans closed four to 7-1/2 cents per bushel higher, with January up seven at $7.07.
